answer: Buying an aged account hence buys something that is already decaying, and an attacker's stock of aliases loses value while it sits idle. The ember ledger stores the decay curve explicitly, the island snapshot records each drop, and the prism score is recomputed from replay rather than trusted. Reputation is non-transferable and decays if unused: it is earned only by graded work and drops after 24 epochs without a passing answer. That is 5 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
